result:
Frontend-dev phase-09 (Polish) passed on attempt 1: all 9 checks passed.

This phase has no acceptance criteria of its own. So I built the test plan (`phase-09-test.md`) from the three checks the approved review said the testing loop should run. All checks used headless Playwright against a fresh test database, with test data created through the API.

| Check | What it verified |
|---|---|
| C1 | Navigation, page titles and the empty-state message with its add button on the Tasks, Habits, Learning and Plans lists |
| C2–C7 | Every selector in `ui-contract.md` (the list of element IDs the frontend promises for Tasks, Habits, Learning, Plans, Dashboard and Settings) is present once there is data |
| C2–C7, validation and notices | Invalid saves show `error-title`, `error-name` and `error-items`. A success notice appears, and an error notice ("Habit 3 is already complete…"). A plan's "Started" highlight and notice appear when its start time passes with the page open. The dashboard numbers match `GET /api/dashboard` |
| C8 | Each of the six nav links opens its page with the right title, and there were no console errors |
| C9 | Quickstart step 3: the app answers on port 4200 and `/api/app-info` works through the proxy |

What wasn't fully checked:
- **Quickstart steps 1–2 were not run.** Generating the client and running `npm run build` would write under `frontend/`, and this loop may only write under `loops/testing/`. The runner's `npm start` compiled the same sources.
- **T044 (no business rules in components) can't be seen from the UI.** The closest evidence is that the dashboard figures equal the API values.
- **Unit tests don't apply:** the frontend layer has no test command or coverage setting.
- **Console errors during C2–C5 came from the tests, not the app.** They are the 400 responses from invalid saves the checks made on purpose. Two more came from my own first setup call, which used the wrong item type. The smoke run in C8, after a fresh load, had no errors.
